messages:
maria-partnerships: Kickoff — Stratus Connect (carrier + fiber partner) asked us to light eu-west4-stratus-edge1 next quarter. Need marketplace quota, dedicated SKU approval, SI integration plan, and joint announcement coordination. Target public launch 2025-05-15. Who can drive quotas & carrier provisioning? cc: @ajay-ops @linus-infra @tara-legal :rocket:
ajay-ops: I can own the marketplace quota request and capacity numbers. Maria, can you post expected steady/peak RPS and GPU mix so I can size the request?
maria-partnerships: Expected steady ~350 RPS, peak ~1.2k RPS first 30 days. Model mix: text generation (large), embeddings. Preferred reserved HW: A100 class; fallback T4 for low-priority jobs.
linus-infra: For carrier + colocation we'll need Stratus ASN, on-net schedule and cross-connect contacts. Also confirm whether we need public IP space or overlay. @maria-partnerships please share network contact.
sam-platform: I'll take SI integration and runbook. Estimate 3 engineers x 4 weeks for initial integration and validation. Plan: canary on a single pool in eu-west4, validate perf and KV cache behavior, then regional rollout. I'll draft playbook.
tara-legal: Heads up — NDA amendment for joint announcement + co-marketing required. Also flag on carrier SLA liability & uptime language. Need embargo window.
maria-partnerships: Embargo internal 2025-05-01, public 2025-05-15. Stratus wants a joint announcement on launch day.
ajay-ops: Drafting quota request now: 'dedicated-gpu: 4x A100 nodes + 8x T4 nodes reserved, burst +50% for initial 30d.' I'll open ticket by EOD. Any objections?
linus-infra: No objections. Two infra notes: 1) dedicated nodes require KMS/HSM plan; 2) we need to pre-provision KV cache backing store for edge pool.
maria-partnerships: Stratus said they can provide partner KMS gateway/HSM. They'll do key custody via their HSM and want our key-wrap. @nina-security please validate.
nina-security: Quick check — partner KMS gateway is acceptable if we perform key wrapping, full audit logging, and retention config. Legal should include key custody clause. Tara, can you add to NDA addendum?
deploy-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/partners/stratus-edge-runbook — please review and comment.
sam-platform: I'll pilot the runbook with the SI next week and run the canary. Who will funnel staged traffic from Stratus for tests?
maria-partnerships: Stratus will route staged customers via a carrier test pool. I'll introduce Ajay and Linus to their network PM (emma@stratus) right after this thread.
ajay-ops: Submitted quota ticket #Q-4721 to marketplace. ETA approval 3-5 business days, will update here once approved.
tara-legal: NDA amendment draft uploaded: https://legal/redwood/stratus-nda-draft — please review by Tuesday EOD. Focus on key custody, co-marketing approvals, and embargo language.
linus-infra: Cross-connect window booked 2025-04-20 -> 2025-04-22. Fiber vendor confirmed lead times; Stratus confirmed on-net date. Blockers: provide ASN and PO details.
maria-partnerships: Thanks all. Next sync Thu 09:30 PT — agenda: quota status, SI resourcing, legal signoffs, press checklist. :calendar: 
ajay-ops: 👍 will post ticket updates in thread.
linus-infra: :thumbsup: will prep network runbook entries.
tara-legal: :eyes: reviewing NDA now.
maria-partnerships: Closing for now — assigning action owners in follow-ups. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
